fixed: Importing a program from ContraDB now links a slot to a dance you already have, when The Caller's Box fallback finds one with the same figures, instead of leaving the dance as a note.
You can now re-import a Caller's Companion file onto a program whose venue was removed entirely, and the program's location links to a venue again instead of keeping a dead link.
Saving a dialect you were editing no longer adds a second copy if it was renamed meanwhile, or brings it back if it was deleted; you see a message that your changes weren't saved.
Restoring a dance or program from Recently deleted no longer says "restored" when another device had permanently deleted it in the meantime.
Searching custom number fields no longer matches a stray "0" for whole numbers such as 3, and a trashed dance's search entry no longer keeps text from a custom field that was deleted and recreated.
Index whole-number custom values as "3" rather than "3.0"; a one-time `ensureMigrated` pass behind `customNumberIndexRepairDoneKey` reindexes the dances holding a value for a number field.
Reindex the trashed dances whose custom-field values are deleted when a recreated field adopts a tombstoned definition's key.
A Caller's Companion re-import resolves the program's venue afresh when the prior `venueId` names no row at all, live or tombstoned (`VenueRepository.rowExists`).
`resolveConfidentOnlineDanceId` returns the existing dance's id for a confident match with identical figures.
